title: Learning-Based Model Predictive Control: Toward Safe Learning in Control
authors: L. Hewing, K. P. Wabersich, M. Menner and M. N. Zeilinger
scope: Taxonomy of learning within and around MPC; no universal safety guarantee.

title: A predictive safety filter for learning-based control of constrained nonlinear dynamical systems
authors: K. P. Wabersich and M. N. Zeilinger
scope: Conditional predictive safety construction, not a safety certification for a methane plant.

title: On Average Performance and Stability of Economic Model Predictive Control
authors: D. Angeli, R. Amrit and J. B. Rawlings
scope: Economic MPC performance and stability under stated mathematical assumptions.

title: Stochastic Model Predictive Control: An Overview and Perspectives for Future Research
access: Indexed author-repository abstract; direct page challenged
scope: Uncertainty-aware MPC; different formulations have different guarantees and computational demands.

title: Optimization of Conditional Value-at-Risk
authors: R. T. Rockafellar and S. Uryasev
scope: Tail-risk optimization technique, originally illustrated in finance; plant objective is an application proposal.

title: Combination of Site-Wide and Real-Time Optimization for the Control of Systems of Electrolyzers
authors: V. Henkel, L. P. Wagner, F. Gehlhoff and A. Fay
scope: Hierarchical electrolyser scheduling and real-time control; not evidence of whole-plant unattended recovery.

title: Q-learning-based stochastic model predictive control for green ammonia production
authors: H. M. Park, T. H. Oh and J. M. Lee
access: Indexed publisher abstract and highlights; direct full text unavailable
scope: Simulation of ammonia production with a learned terminal Q-function; transfer to methane remains to be tested.

title: Reinforcement Learning in Process Industries: Review and Perspective
scope: Process-industry RL landscape across control and related tasks; individual deployment claims need their own evidence.

title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning
authors: A. Kumar, A. Zhou, G. Tucker and S. Levine
scope: Addresses offline value overestimation; does not certify safety or fill missing operating-regime coverage.

title: Homeostatic reinforcement learning for integrating reward collection and physiological stability
scope: Drive reduction, reward and physiological regulation; no industrial plant experiment.

title: Modeling long-term nutritional behaviors using deep homeostatic reinforcement learning
authors: N. Yoshida, E. Arikawa, H. Kanazawa and Y. Kuniyoshi
scope: Long-term nutritional behaviour in simulated agents; not plant control validation.

title: Linking Homeostasis to Reinforcement Learning: Internal State Control of Motivated Behavior
authors: N. Yoshida, H. Sprekeler and B. Gutkin
scope: Conceptual synthesis of internal-state-dependent motivation, anticipation and hierarchical behaviour.

title: Gradual proactive regulation of body state by reinforcement learning of homeostasis
authors: Mana Fujiwara and Honda Naoki (as indexed by PubMed)
scope: Proactive regulation and interacting internal variables in a computational model; industrial application is untested.

title: Simulating homeostatic, allostatic and goal-directed forms of interoceptive control using active inference
authors: A. Tschantz, L. Barca, D. Maisto, C. L. Buckley, A. K. Seth and G. Pezzulo
scope: Generative-model simulations of three forms of regulation; not a plant recovery demonstration.

title: Policy Invariance Under Reward Transformations: Theory and Application to Reward Shaping
authors: A. Y. Ng, D. Harada and S. Russell
scope: Potential-based reward shaping under stated MDP and discount assumptions.

title: Smart ‘Predict, then Optimize’
authors: A. N. Elmachtoub and P. Grigas
scope: Prediction trained around downstream decision loss; application to weather dispatch is a proposal.

title: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
scope: Adaptive long-run coverage; not a conditional or joint physical-safety guarantee.

title: Sensor Placement for Fault Diagnosis
access: Indexed author-hosted PDF and author publication record; direct PDF retrieval failed
scope: Structural detectability and isolability; actual signal quality and operating excitation remain relevant.

title: Fault Diagnosis Toolbox for Python and Matlab
scope: Structural analysis, isolability, sensor placement and residual generation tooling.

title: A Survey of Active Fault Diagnosis Methods
access: Indexed publisher abstract; bibliographic authors corroborated by university-hosted reference
scope: Auxiliary-input design for diagnosis under uncertainty; specific probes require plant constraints.

title: Joint Optimization of Sampling and Control of Partially Observable Failing Systems
authors: M. J. Kim and V. Makis
scope: Joint observation/maintenance decisions in a particular partially observed failing-system model.

title: Electrolyzer Durability at Low Catalyst Loading and with Dynamic Operation
authors: S. M. Alia, S. Stariha and R. L. Borup
scope: PEM technology and specified catalyst/loading/cycling conditions; coefficients must not be transferred to alkaline equipment.

title: Power-to-Gas: Process analysis and control strategies for dynamic catalytic methanation system
authors: L. Colelli, C. Bassano, N. Verdone, V. Segneri and G. Vilardi
access: Indexed publisher abstract/excerpts; direct full text unavailable
scope: Dynamic methanation modelling and thermal control; does not calibrate the current lumped reactor fixture.

title: A Model-Based Approach to Reactive Self-Configuring Systems
authors: B. C. Williams and P. P. Nayak
access: AAAI paper record and author manuscript excerpt
scope: Model-based diagnosis/reconfiguration precedent; predefined physical alternatives bound recovery.

title: Computer Program Assumes Spacecraft Command
scope: Remote Agent taking command for a bounded spacecraft test; announcement is not a final performance report.

title: Quantifying forecast uncertainty
scope: Ensemble weather uncertainty; local PV conversion and calibration remain separate tasks.

title: do-mpc documentation
scope: Nonlinear/robust MPC and moving-horizon estimation tooling; not a certified controller.

title: CasADi documentation
scope: Symbolic differentiation and optimization interfaces.

title: acados documentation
scope: Fast optimal-control problem solvers; not a direct replacement for a mixed-integer scheduling solver.

title: Gymnasium documentation
scope: Standard environment interfaces and seeding; observation separation is the environment author's responsibility.

title: Building Optimization Testing Framework (BOPTEST)
scope: Reproducible building-control benchmarking precedent; its buildings are not methane-plant models.

title: safe-control-gym: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Safe Learning-based Control and Reinforcement Learning in Robotics
scope: Robotics benchmark pattern for safety/performance comparisons; not plant validation.

title: Yokogawa and JSR Use AI to Autonomously Control a Chemical Plant for 35 Consecutive Days
authors: Yokogawa Electric Corporation and JSR Corporation
scope: Control of a distillation column with existing protection and monitoring; title is broader than the described test boundary.

title: Autonomous AI Control of Mission-Critical Cooling at Merck
scope: Cooling setpoint control with local BMS handover; not independently audited general fault repair.

title: 3 Reasons Your Refinery Needs Closed-Loop AI Optimization
scope: Named refinery closed-loop optimization and retraining after feed changes; no cross-vendor benchmark.

title: Rivan deploys full-scale 1MW system
scope: Deployment and commissioning; extended autonomous performance remains to be established by the cited announcement.

title: Terraform Industries
scope: Company-reported sunlight/air-to-gas demonstration in March 2024; no broad fault-recovery benchmark.

title: gPROMS for sustainability
scope: Process modelling and digital twins, including hydrogen applications; tool availability is not deployment validation.

title: Robotic Gas Leak Detection with ANYmal
scope: Mobile gas inspection and detection capability; repair and process control are separate functions.

title: Machine Health
scope: Machine condition monitoring and diagnostic support; rotating-equipment evidence does not establish catalyst or electrolyser remaining life.

title: Raptor Maps
scope: Solar inspection and remote drone operations; capability claims are company supplied.

title: Solar PV Inspection Drone Flight Guidelines
scope: Provider-specific thermography conditions, including irradiance; not a universal inspection standard.
